segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You look at the frosty trees, then remember what Pip told you just two minutes ago.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say, pointing down the mountain toward the dark valley.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: You said your headquarters is at the old mill... by the frozen river.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: And a mill is run by waterwheels and giant cogs,

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: The riddle says the cog turns where the cold river lies. The secret cog isn't at the North Pole. It's hidden inside your mill!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For five seconds, Pip stared at you with his mouth open. His whiskers twitched.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then, his eyes narrowed, he snapped his little notebook shut with a loud SLAP, and cleared his throat with supreme dignity:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Ahem! Splendid! I wondered when you would finally catch up!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip said breezily, waving a paw in the air.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: An open-and-shut deduction! I was merely withholding the solution to allow your youthful, developing mind to stretch its investigative legs. Consider it a masterclass in field training. You're welcome.
